Container.Name: Schema
Container.Overview: Schema is a web-native media organizer and renamer for movies, TV and anime, replacing FileBot and the jlesage/filebot noVNC container. It matches files against TMDb, TheTVDB, AniDB, Trakt and TVmaze, shows a reviewable preview of every rename, and moves, copies or links files with conflict policies, sidecar handling and full undo. Watch folders, SABnzbd/qBittorrent webhooks and Plex/Jellyfin/Emby refresh are built in. FileBot-style formats such as {n} - {s00e00} - {t} work as-is. The volume layout matches jlesage/filebot (/config, /storage, /watch, /output).
Container.ExtraParams: --security-opt no-new-privileges --cap-drop ALL --cap-add CHOWN --cap-add DAC_OVERRIDE --cap-add FOWNER --cap-add SETGID --cap-add SETUID --pids-limit 256 --memory 1536m --cpus 2 --stop-timeout 120
Container.Requires: Build the image first: docker build -t schema-media:latest /path/to/schema_media_renaming

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Schema web interface and API (webhooks use it too).

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Database, provider cache, trash for replaced files, secret key. Back this up.

Config.Name: Storage
Config.Description: ONE share holding both your downloads and your media (e.g. data/downloads and data/media), so moves are instant renames. Never all of /mnt/user: it contains appdata. Add the folders Schema may touch under Settings -> Allowed roots.

Config.Name: Watch folder
Config.Description: Optional: the folder FileBot's AMC watched. A separate mount, so files moved from it are copied; a folder under Storage is faster. Add it as a watch folder in Schema.

Config.Name: Output folder
Config.Description: Optional: where FileBot's AMC wrote renamed files. A separate mount, so files moved into it are copied; a folder under Storage is faster. Use it as a library root in Schema.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id Schema runs as (Unraid: 99 = nobody). USER_ID is accepted too. 0 (root) is refused unless SCHEMA_ALLOW_ROOT=1.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id Schema runs as (Unraid: 100 = users). GROUP_ID is accepted too. 0 (root) is refused unless SCHEMA_ALLOW_ROOT=1.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Permission mask (octal) for new files and folders. 022: only PUID can write them; 002: the PGID group too. 000 makes renamed media writable by everyone.

Config.Name: Allowed hosts
Config.Description: Host names and IPs you open Schema with, comma separated (e.g. tower.local,192.168.1.20). Blocks DNS-rebinding pages from reaching the API; empty answers any host.

Config.Name: Authentication
Config.Description: required (default) or disabled. Only disable on a trusted LAN.

Config.Name: TMDb API key
Config.Description: Optional. Better: enter it in the UI (Settings -> Providers); a variable is readable by anyone who can run docker inspect.

Config.Name: TheTVDB API key
Config.Description: Optional. Better: enter it in the UI (Settings -> Providers).
